decisions.reason: The source decision concerns optional population of two connectors on the legacy main board, not the separate power-board BOM.
The sensor-board BOM remains unaffected by a population decision for connectors on the legacy main board.
Optional assembly of the connectors does not change the legacy main-board dimensions, fit, or routing requirements.
The source addresses BOM population of two unspecified ESP32-adjacent connectors and does not alter the defined interboard connector types, pinouts, or power and signal roles.
The connectors remain in the design, so making their assembly optional does not change connector placement, orientation, or alignment rules.
Connector population cost and ordering do not change the four-layer main-board stack.
The source does not identify the connectors as I2C conditioning components and does not change pull-ups, series resistors, topology, or signal parameters.
The source does not identify the optional ESP32-adjacent connectors as any required panel-control connector, so the panel-control inventory remains unchanged.
The source concerns two connectors on the legacy main board and does not change the sensor-board fanout inventory or connector-consolidation policy.
The source does not refer to J_LED_CHG, R6, D1, or any other part of the battery-charge status interface.
Optional connector population in the legacy main-board BOM does not alter the required sensor-board fabrication and placement exports.
The source does not change the USB auxiliary regulator, source-selection behavior, powered rail, or standalone-programming support.
